title: Townsend Brown and the Caroline Group

tellings.quote: And then Townsend Brown also runs into this sort of, you know, the Caroline Group, this international group of industrialists that seem to suck up all of the exotic tech.

plain: The American inventor Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have crossed paths with what Michels calls the Caroline Group, an international circle of industrialists that, in his words, seemed to "suck up all of the exotic tech." Michels tells this himself on a 2026 episode, without naming a source. If true, it would mean that unusual inventions were being quietly gathered up by private money rather than reaching the public.
